title: Fix RBF nsequence: canonical value, all inputs

traits.evidence: lib/src/bitcoin/script/op_code/constant.dart: replaceByFeeSequence [0x01,0x00,0x00,0x00] -> [0xfd,0xff,0xff,0xff]; transaction_builder.dart + forked_transaction_builder.dart: `if (enableRBF && inputs.isNotEmpty) inputs[0] = ...` -> loop sets RBF sequence on every input

summary: RBF-signalling sends would set nSequence 0xFFFFFFFD on every input, replacing 0x01 on input 0 only (which also imposed a 1-block BIP-68 relative timelock).
notes: Library PR in Cake's fork. It targets the fork's `main` branch, but Cake pins branch `cake-update-v11` (commit 4e41f96f), which still has the old code, so the change reaches Cake only once ported to that branch and the pin is bumped. Upstream mrtnetwork/bitcoin_base merged the same change as #21 (2026-07-11). Cake's PSBT/hardware path was already switched to 0xFFFFFFFD by merged cake_wallet #3077. Cake software sends set enableRBF = !spendsUnconfirmedTX.

title: fix silent OP_RETURN writting on bip-21 opening

traits.after: yes (only from an explicit memo; no longer auto-filled from BIP-21 message)
traits.evidence: lib/new-ui/pages/send_page.dart: `_memoControllers[0].text = ...note` -> `_applyPaymentRequestNote(note, i)`, which writes to the memo (-> OP_RETURN) only when sendViewModel.hasMemos, otherwise to a local note

summary: Opening a BIP-21 URI or QR code would stop silently adding the payee's `message` text as an OP_RETURN output on Bitcoin sends.
notes: New-UI send page only. The author says it is untested ('vibe coded, as a courtesy'). OP_RETURN still appears for memos set elsewhere (e.g. swap memos), so the catalog value stays 'yes' but these outputs become rarer.

title: Cw 1678 disable address types other than segwit and taproot by default

traits.after: P2WPKH/P2TR by default (P2PKH, P2SH-P2WPKH, P2WSH opt-in)
traits.evidence: cw_bitcoin/lib/electrum_wallet_addresses.dart: new OPTIONAL_BITCOIN_ADDRESS_TYPES = [p2pkh, p2wsh, p2wpkhInP2sh] + isAddressTypeEnabledFor(); electrum_wallet.dart: disabled types skip derivation, subscription, history fetch and unspent updates (activeAddresses)

summary: Bitcoin wallets stop deriving and tracking P2PKH, P2SH-P2WPKH and P2WSH addresses unless the user enables them, so by default sends spend only P2WPKH/P2TR inputs.
notes: New Addresses settings screen re-enables the legacy types (not on hardware wallets). The UTXO effect is indirect: disabled types are not subscribed, so their coins are not loaded for spending. Mixing P2WPKH with P2TR stays possible, so single_type is still 'no'. I did not verify how existing wallets with legacy-type funds are migrated.

title: Custom block explorers

traits.evidence: cw_bitcoin/lib/electrum_wallet.dart updateFeeRates(): hard-coded https://mempool.cakewallet.com/api/v1/fees/recommended -> fetchMempoolApi('/api/v1/fees/recommended') using the CustomBlockExplorers.mempoolApiPrefsKey pref; cw_core/lib/custom_block_explorers.dart mempoolApiUris() never falls back to Cake's server when a custom base is set

summary: Users can point fee estimation at their own mempool.space instance, so the fee rate Cake picks may come from a different estimator.
notes: Opt-in (custom block explorer setting). Defaults are unchanged.

title: Switch to cake.mempool.space
summary: The default fee-rate source would move from Cake's mempool host to cake.mempool.space.
notes: Possibly a host migration with the same estimator, so the on-chain effect on fee rates may be nil. Open since 2025-09 and probably stale. Also changes the default Electrum node to cake.mempool.space:50002.

title: payjoin: exclude 0-conf inputs from receiver candidates
summary: As a payjoin receiver, Bull would stop contributing unconfirmed UTXOs to the payjoin transaction.
notes: Payjoin receiver path only; normal sends are unaffected. Cake merged the equivalent change (cake_wallet #3389). Ref: payjoin/rust-payjoin#1597.

title: feat(send): support multiple bitcoin recipients

traits.evidence: lib/core/wallet/data/datasources/bdk_wallet_datasource.dart buildPsbt: `required String address, int? amountSat` -> `required List<BitcoinTransactionRecipientModel> recipients`, looping `txBuilder.addRecipient(...)` per recipient (one optional drainTo remainder recipient)

summary: On-chain sends could pay several recipients in one transaction (batched outputs plus change), where before Bull always paid a single recipient.
notes: Opt-in (user adds recipients; the single-recipient flow is unchanged). Payjoin is disabled for multi-recipient transactions. Stacked PR: it depends on #2745 (UTXO sweep), which I excluded because it reuses the existing manual-selection/drain path.

title: feat(payjoin): independent Receive / Trade / Send payjoin settings

traits.before: payjoin off by default (global setting, disclaimer-gated)
traits.after: payjoin on by default for Bull exchange buy/sell/bill-pay orders
traits.evidence: packages/bull_payjoin (Drift schema v2): `BoolColumn get tradingEnabled => boolean().withDefault(const Constant(true))()`; PR body: 'Even with global payjoin off (the default), buy/sell/pay orders use payjoin out of the box.'

summary: Exchange-trade payments to and from Bull Bitcoin would default to payjoin transactions (both sides contribute inputs) instead of plain sends.
notes: Affects only exchange-trade flows (Bull is the counterparty). Wallet-to-wallet payjoin stays off by default. Users can turn it off with the new 'Payjoin trading enabled' toggle.

title: fix(send): harden fee loading and transaction construction

traits.after: mempool.bullbitcoin.com (embedded-Tor retry); cached or fixed fallback when unreachable
traits.evidence: lib/core/fees/data/fees_repository_impl.dart: _fetchBitcoinNetworkFees() adds external-proxy / embedded-Tor routes; lib/features/send/domain/usecases/load_send_fees_usecase.dart: on failure uses previousBitcoinFees ?? _buildFallbackBitcoinFees()

traits.after: round only if custom, or 1 sat/vB when fee APIs fail

summary: When no fee estimate can be fetched, sends would fall back to the last fetched rates or a flat 1 sat/vB, where before the send failed.
notes: Edge case only (all fee paths down). The UI shows a warning and the user can still set a custom fee.

title: feat(bullvault): add descriptor wallet and vault workflows

traits.after: P2WPKH, plus P2WSH/P2TR miniscript inputs from BullVault/descriptor wallets
traits.evidence: lib/core/wallet/data/datasources/bdk_wallet_datasource.dart: buildPsbt gains `BitcoinPolicyPath? policyPath` -> `txBuilder.policyPath(...)` for external/internal descriptors; `isTaproot: parsedDescriptor.externalDescriptor.startsWith('tr(')`

traits.after: CSV relative-timelock value on vault recovery-path spends
traits.evidence: bdk_wallet_datasource.dart: `if (!replaceByFee && policyPath?.requiresRelativeTimelock != true)` keeps setExactSequence off so BDK sets the CSV sequence for timelocked paths

summary: Adds BullVault/descriptor wallets that spend miniscript P2WSH/P2TR outputs (multisig, timelocked recovery and inheritance paths), which are new input script types for Bull.
notes: Opt-in (new BullVault/descriptor-import feature). Very large PR (300+ files); I read only the BDK datasource patch via the files API. Open PRs #2824 and #2832 appear to bundle the same commits. Note: current develop's comment says bdk_dart defaults to nSequence 0xFFFFFFFD, which conflicts with the catalog's MAX for Bull. I kept the catalog value as 'before'.

title: [privacy] Implement Joinstr coinjoin (proof of concept)

traits.evidence: lib/features/joinstr/data/joinstr_datasource.dart (comment): 'we broadcast a SIGHASH_ALL|SIGHASH_ANYONECANPAY signature over the coin'

traits.after: Joinstr equal-denomination coinjoin (one input per peer)
traits.evidence: lib/features/joinstr/domain/joinstr.dart: denominationSat pools, isEligibleCoin(denomination+500 <= value <= denomination+5000); uses joinstr_flutter bindings

summary: Adds a Joinstr coinjoin flow: one input per peer with ANYONECANPAY signatures, paying equal-denomination outputs.
notes: Draft proof of concept behind superuser settings, testnet only, hot BIP84 wallets only, so there is no mainnet effect yet. Tx construction happens in the external rust-joinstr/joinstr_flutter bindings.
